definitions.explanation: Having a sacred, awe-inspiring beauty or grandeur that evokes a sense of the divine.

examples.japanese: {神々|こうごう}しい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧。
⟦{朝日|あさひ}→朝日：23495_asahi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神々|こうごう}しかった。
examples.english: The mountain illuminated by the morning sun was majestic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{神々|こうごう}しい⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: When I stepped into the forest of the old shrine, I was enveloped in a sublime atmosphere.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Derived from ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧ (god/deity). The repetition {神々|かみがみ} means "gods" (plural), and the しい suffix creates an adjective meaning "having the quality of gods."

USAGE:
Used to describe places, scenes, or atmospheres that evoke a sacred or transcendent quality. Particularly common when describing natural scenery, temples, shrines, and moments of extraordinary beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神々|こうごう}しい⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: sacred atmosphere
- {神々|こうごう}しい⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: divine light
- {神々|こうごう}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: majestic figure
